hook: How well do you know the story of Bengal? Ten questions, a few surprises.
disclaimer: This quiz is just for fun and inspiration. It's a light-hearted reflection, not a measure of expertise.

tiers.title: Curious Reader
tiers.message: Every great story starts with curiosity. The stories behind the questions you missed are a good place to continue.

tiers.title: Story Seeker
tiers.message: You're finding the threads. Keep pulling, because each story connects to the next.

tiers.title: Story Keeper
tiers.message: You carry a good deal of Bengal's story. Try another topic to widen the map.

tiers.title: Bengal Explorer
tiers.message: Sharp eye. You moved through the story with confidence; now go deeper into the sources.
